newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S SUPER-G WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S SUPER-G WINNER.

text.p: The following is a profile of the winner of the men's super-giant slalom at the Alpine skiing world championships on Monday:
World Cup wins: Seven (six downhill, 1 super-G)

Other facts: Defending super-G world champion and 1993 downhill silver medallist. A quiet, calm man who lives in the Austrian city of Salzburg, he has not won in World Cup this season but finished second in downhills at Chamonix and Val Gardena. These championships are his seventh dating back to 1985. Celebrates his 31st birthday on February 17.
